passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Uhud deployment; two groups almost lost courage Allah was their ally; let believers rely on Allah; Badr victory recalled when few; fear Allah be grateful; reinforcement with 3000 angels descending; if patient and fear Allah and enemy comes suddenly 5000 marked angels; glad tidings and reassurance only; victory only from Allah Aziz Hakeem; cut off or suppress disbelievers so return frustrated; not for you whether He forgives or punishes they are wrongdoers; to Allah belongs heavens earth forgives whom wills punishes whom wills Ghafur Raheem; prohibition of riba doubled multiplied; fear Allah succeed; fear Fire prepared for disbelievers; obey Allah and Messenger receive mercy; hasten to forgiveness and Garden wide as heavens earth prepared for muttaqin; who spend in ease and hardship restrain anger pardon people Allah loves muhsinin; who commit indecency or wrong self remember Allah seek forgiveness for sins who forgives except Allah do not persist knowingly; reward forgiveness and Gardens rivers flowing abiding excellent reward of workers

arabicExcerpts.text: وَإِذۡ غَدَوۡتَ مِنۡ أَهۡلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مَقَٰعِدَ لِلۡقِتَالِۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
إِذۡ هَمَّت طَّآئِفَتَانِ مِنكُمۡ أَن تَفۡشَلَا وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَاۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
وَلَقَدۡ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدۡرٖ وَأَنتُمۡ أَذِلَّةٞۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
إِذۡ تَقُولُ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ أَلَن يَكۡفِيَكُمۡ أَن يُمِدَّكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِثَلَٰثَةِ ءَالَٰفٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُنزَلِينَ
بَلَىٰٓۚ إِن تَصۡبِرُواْ وَتَتَّقُواْ وَيَأۡتُوكُم مِّن فَوۡرِهِمۡ هَٰذَا يُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِخَمۡسَةِ ءَالَٰفٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشۡرَىٰ لَكُمۡ وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُم بِهِۦۗ وَمَا ٱلنَّصۡرُ إِلَّا مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
لِيَقۡطَعَ طَرَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَوۡ يَكۡبِتَهُمۡ فَيَنقَلِبُواْ خَآئِبِينَ
لَيۡسَ لَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ شَيۡءٌ أَوۡ يَتُوبَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَوۡ يُعَذِّبَهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ يَغۡفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَأۡكُلُواْ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓاْ أَضۡعَٰفٗا مُّضَٰعَفَةٗۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ
۞وَسَارِعُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ مَغۡفِرَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ أُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلۡكَٰظِمِينَ ٱلۡغَيۡظَ وَٱلۡعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ

وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُواْ فَٰحِشَةً أَوۡ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ ذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرُواْ لِذُنُوبِهِمۡ وَمَن يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَلَمۡ يُصِرُّواْ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُواْ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ

mainSubject.label: Uhud battle context: Prophet assigning stations; two parties nearly faltered but Allah was their protector; tawakkul command; Badr victory recalled as precedent of divine aid despite weakness; gratitude linked to taqwa; angelic reinforcement promised: 3000 descending angels, escalating to 5000 marked angels conditional on sabr and taqwa during sudden attack; angelic aid as bushra and heart-reassurance only; victory exclusively from Allah al-Aziz al-Hakeem; strategic purpose: cutting down or suppressing disbelievers to frustrate them; prophetic non-agency over divine forgiveness/punishment decision; universal divine ownership; Ghafur Raheem; riba prohibition with emphasis on compounding multiplication; fire warning for disbelievers; obedience to Allah and Messenger as path to mercy; racing toward maghfirah and Jannah spanning heavens and earth prepared for muttaqin; defining traits of muttaqin: spending in prosperity and adversity, restraining anger (kazimin al-ghayth), pardoning people (afeena an al-nas), Allah loves muhsinin; repentance pattern: committing fahishah or self-wrong, remembering Allah, seeking forgiveness, not persisting knowingly; rhetorical question: who forgives sins except Allah; reward: maghfirah and gardens with rivers, eternal abode, excellent reward of amilin

notes: Pass A Imran passage 15/16. Densest passage in this range covering Uhud, Badr, angelic reinforcement, riba, and muttaqin ethics. Kazimin al-ghayth (3:134) is primary Quranic anger-management text. Riba verse (3:130) specifies compounding (ad'afan muda'afah). Repentance formula (3:135) most detailed in Quran. Ni'ma ajr al-amilin closes with worker-reward motif.
